label: preparing
what: A coordinated, partly confidential gathering in the great hall at eighteen hundred, with the mayor attending and being escorted by the secretary. Innkeeper organizes and privately finances bread refreshments; builder has installed eight lanterns free and freight is named as helping. Baker knowingly supplies bread for tonight's gathering. The gathering's full purpose remains undisclosed; a celebration of the mayor's forty years of service is plausible but unconfirmed.
